Each link is a sub-issue relationship obot will apply (child under parent) once @jwildfire approves it on the deployed page; flags are cleanup calls that are not links. Keys are owner/repo#number. Written by the 2026-07-27 roadmap-cleanup session; edit or empty the lists as decisions land — applied links disappear from the Proposed diff on the next deploy because the live tree already has them.
